'''Zitontown'''<ref name="The Galactic Explorer's Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref> was a run-down [[mining]] [[City|town]] located on the [[planet]] [[Mustafar]], precariously perched on a ledge overlooking a river of [[Magma|lava]]. The settlement contained a mining facility and ramshackle houses, which were towered over by a [[Black Sun fortress|fortified compound]]<ref name="Dark Disciple" /> that served as headquarters of the [[Black Sun]] syndicate during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="Black Sun">{{Databank|black-sun|Black Sun}}</ref> The town was named<ref name="The Galactic Explorer's Guide" /> for [[Ziton Moj]], a senior Black Sun [[Vigo]] who became leader of the organization during the conflict.<ref name="Helmet Collection 39">{{HelmetCollectionCite|39|Databank A-Z}}</ref> [[The Last Resort]] was the only [[Cantina|bar]] in Zitontown. A landing platform was located at the edge of the settlement.<ref name="Dark Disciple" />
